description: High-Resolution Floating Solar PV Data is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Manjunath Matam, Rebecca R. Hernandez. This dataset contains over two years of 1-minute resolution data collected from four floating solar sites, as well as data from a land-based PV system co-located with one of the floating sites. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 20 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
